answer: Each vertex’s reputation is discounted by exponential temporal decay with a fixed half-life, so credit persists only through sustained honest service. EigenTrust-style centrality propagates over trusted, reciprocity-weighted links; freshly spawned Sybil identities have almost no trusted incoming support and therefore near-zero eigenvector centrality. The fable of mutual endorsements cannot turn a tundra of isolated identities into credible trust or raise them above consensus thresholds.
